privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.sub: This desktop pet is a personal hobby project.
privacy.desc: DeskBud desktop pet privacy and data collection notes
privacy.p1: This app does not collect or upload any personal information, and does not scan or read your local documents or window contents.
privacy.p2: The app only proactively downloads the public bubble-quote config file bubble.json; it never submits any local information outward.
privacy.p3: All settings and pet states are stored on your local device; there is no cloud storage.
privacy.p4: When the network is down, the app uses built-in default data and all core features work normally.
privacy.p5: This app integrates no data-collection, analytics, or advertising SDKs.
